title: Severe bleeding (Earth reference, no space data)

steps.text: Press firmly and directly on the bleeding wound with your hand.

source.guideline: Djärv T, Rogers J, Semeraro F, et al. European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2025 First Aid. Resuscitation. 2025;215:110752. doi:10.1016/j.resuscitation.2025.110752 (Earth reference, no space data)
source.section: Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Control of life-threatening bleeding

steps.text: Put a standard or haemostatic dressing directly into the wound, then press firmly on top of the dressing.

source.guideline: Djärv T, Rogers J, Semeraro F, et al. European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2025 First Aid. Resuscitation. 2025;215:110752. doi:10.1016/j.resuscitation.2025.110752 (Earth reference, no space data)
source.section: Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Control of life-threatening bleeding

steps.text: Once the bleeding is under control, apply a pressure dressing.

source.guideline: Djärv T, Rogers J, Semeraro F, et al. European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2025 First Aid. Resuscitation. 2025;215:110752. doi:10.1016/j.resuscitation.2025.110752 (Earth reference, no space data)
source.section: Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Control of life-threatening bleeding

steps.text: If life-threatening bleeding from an arm or leg is not controlled by direct pressure, apply a tourniquet as soon as possible and write the time on it.

source.guideline: Djärv T, Rogers J, Semeraro F, et al. European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2025 First Aid. Resuscitation. 2025;215:110752. doi:10.1016/j.resuscitation.2025.110752 (Earth reference, no space data)
source.section: Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Control of life-threatening bleeding, tourniquet
